name: Chicago Community Bond Fund
mission: The Chicago Community Bond Fund (CCBF) pays bond for people charged with crimes in Cook County, Illinois. Through a revolving fund, CCBF supports individuals whose communities cannot afford to pay the bonds themselves and who have been impacted by structural violence.
theoryOfChange: By paying bond, CCBF restores the presumption of innocence before trial and enables recipients to remain free while fighting their cases. People free on bond have better case outcomes than people are locked up.
scoreSummary: Chicago Community Bond Fund shows moderate impact and moderate alignment.

evaluationSources: Recognition for advocacy leading to the Illinois Pretrial Fairness Act (Illinois State Legislature/Governor)
